mapper.select: WITH emp00 AS ( SELECT * FROM emp00_trans_info WHERE emp00_all_title = 0 AND emp00_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) , org00 AS ( SELECT org01_code_id AS org00_org_code_id , org02_mod_date AS org00_mod_date FROM org01_code INNER JOIN org02_info ON org02_code_id = org01_code_id WHERE org01_company_id = #{c.companyId} ) SELECT a.apr99_appr_id AS appr_id , a.apr99_reg_date AS reg_date , a.apr99_effect_date AS effect_date , f_class_tree_nm_allpath(dcr01_class_tree_id) AS class_tree_name_all_path , a.apr99_title AS title , c.emp00_org_kor_nm AS apr_org_name , f_emp_kor_nm(c.emp00_person_id) AS apr_person_name , a.apr99_del_date AS del_date , f_emp_kor_nm(a.apr99_del_emp_id) AS del_emp_name FROM apr99_appr_del a LEFT OUTER JOIN dcr01_class_tree b ON a.apr99_class_tree_id = b.dcr01_class_tree_id LEFT OUTER JOIN emp00 c ON a.apr99_reg_emp_id = c.emp00_person_id AND a.apr99_reg_date BETWEEN c.emp00_trans_date AND COALESCE(c.emp00_close_date, to_date('99991231','yyyyMMdd')) LEFT OUTER JOIN apr10_stamp d ON a.apr99_stamp_id = apr10_stamp_id LEFT OUTER JOIN org00 f ON c.emp00_org_code_id = f.org00_org_code_id WHERE 1=1 AND apr99_company_id = #{c.companyId} AND apr99_reg_date BETWEEN #{c.startDate} AND #{c.closeDate} AND apr99_title LIKE #{c.aprName} AND emp00_org_kor_nm LIKE #{c.orgName} AND f_emp_kor_nm(emp00_person_id) LIKE #{c.personName} AND org00_mod_date = ( SELECT MAX(org00_mod_date) FROM org00_org_info WHERE org00_org_code_id = emp00_org_code_id AND org00_mod_date <= emp00_trans_date )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apr01_appr SELECT apr99_appr_id , apr99_title , apr99_reg_date , apr99_status_cd , apr99_content , apr99_note , apr99_reg_emp_id , apr99_effect_date , apr99_class_tree_id , apr99_stamp_id , apr99_receive_nm , apr99_reference_nm , apr99_stamp_seq , apr99_inout_cd , null , null , apr99_company_id , apr99_form_type , apr99_dcr_id_word , apr99_stamp_position , apr99_sign_company , apr99_sign_ceo , apr99_link_cd FROM apr99_appr_del WHERE apr99_appr_id = #{apprId} AND apr99_company_id = #{companyId}
